body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Extract and refine ONLY the central full-body anatomical cybernetic hologram from the supplied UI concept, for use as an isolated transparent PNG asset in a game WebUI. Preserve its beautiful highly detailed glasslike skull, ribs, spine, pelvis, limbs, mechanical anatomy and front-facing pose, arms slightly apart and palms forward, pale pink/coral glow above and cyan rim light below. Anatomical non-sexual gender-neutral medical scan, no flesh/gore. Full body including head, fingers and feet, centered, balanced bilateral anatomy. Tall portrait canvas roughly 1:2.5, body fills 93% of height, ample clear space around both hands, feet near bottom. The body is narrow at torso but the full silhouette including hands occupies most of canvas width. Genuine alpha transparency outside silhouette; semi-transparent glass surfaces and crisp luminous internal anatomy. NO background, no backdrop rectangle, no UI, NO text, NO connector lines, no floor, no pedestal, no frame, no shadow outside figure. Keep the actual anatomy detail and likeness of the supplied reference. Output a production quality isolated body asset; all UI will be rebuilt as HTML.
icons:
Use case: ui-mockup asset sheet. Generate a precisely aligned 4-column by 3-row sprite atlas of 12 isolated cybernetic implant inventory icons, landscape canvas 4:3 (ideally 1536x1152). EXACTLY 12 equal square cells, NO visible cell borders. Every object centered within its cell, occupying 70% of cell width/height with at least 15% transparent padding on all sides so neighboring sprites never touch. Genuine transparent background throughout. NO text, labels, numbers, logos, cards, UI frames, tile backgrounds, shadows or watermark.
Style matches the implant thumbnails of supplied reference UI: photorealistic polished game inventory 3D product renders, metallic gunmetal titanium, intricate wiring and screws, selective gold details, red or cyan status lights, strong clear silhouette, three-quarter view and coherent studio light. These are small surgical mechanical components, not whole people.
Exact row-major order:
Row 1 column 1: cybernetic optical camera eyeball, black titanium cylindrical housing, bright red glass lens, tiny connectors.
Row 1 column 2: cyberdeck processor module, dark rectangular circuit board tilted diagonally with a square cobalt-blue chip center and gold pins.
Row 1 column 3: cybernetic forearm and articulated hand, silver fingers and black tendons, diagonal orientation.
Row 1 column 4: skeletal reinforcement ribcage implant, a small metallic rib assembly with spinal support.
Row 2 column 1: two braided mechanical tendon cables with hydraulic attachments and gold ends.
Row 2 column 2: dermal armor implant, a flexible patch of honeycomb hexagonal metallic scales.
Row 2 column 3: mechanical artificial heart pump, red titanium double chamber with short curved tubes.
Row 2 column 4: blood filtration implant, paired compact red canisters and silver tubing.
Row 3 column 1: metabolic regulator, compact silver medical capsule with yellow fluid chamber and sensor contacts.
Row 3 column 2: ICE neural defense chip, a dark metallic circuit module with a shield-shaped blue luminous core.
Row 3 column 3: neural purge device, compact black and red capacitor pack with exposed copper coils and a cyan indicator.
Row 3 column 4: cybernetic lower leg implant, angled knee joint, shin actuator and compact mechanical foot.
Keep the 4x3 regular grid exact and cell margins generous. All objects rendered at comparable optical size. Reference is style only. Output only the transparent sprite atlas, no interface.
